newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Anaconda says nickel resources increase.
newsitem.headline: Anaconda says nickel resources increase.

text.p: Anaconda Nickel Ltd said on Thursday that the Yundamindra/Eucalyptus project in Western Australia had indicated resources of seven million tonnes at 1.08 percent nickel and 0.08 percent cobalt.
The project, located 45 km southeast of its Murrin Murrin processing plant, had the potential to become a standalone nickel/cobalt development, the company said.
It also said it had acquired two tenements at Yundamindra/Eucalyptus covering 14 square kilometres, with 90 percent acquired from RTZ Plc-CRA Ltd for A$250,000 and the remainder from prospectors.

The A$900 million Murrin Murrin project, located east of the outback town of Leonora, is scheduled to come onstream at the end of 1998 with initial production of 45,000 tonnes of nickel and 3,000 tonnes of cobalt, eventually rising to 75,000 tonnes of nickel and 5,000 tonnes of cobalt.
